summary: Arbitration agreement enforceability under composite transaction; Group of Companies doctrine challenged; NCLT CIRP impact on arbitration; Section 11(6) petition for arbitrator appointment; insolvency stay lifted for counterclaims; doctrine application restricted to 'claiming through or under' nexus; Section 45 interpretation clarified; non-signatory respondent exclusion confirmed.
final_judgment: Reference to larger bench confirmed; Group of Companies doctrine application limited; non-signatory respondent excluded from arbitration; petitioner's Section 11(6) petition maintained for counterclaims against signatory party only.
